set.body: Consumer PLS Neuro B2 bd-01M291CH2240EMTZDY9S4M1RHF. Selected fixed-effects blocks retain aggregate voxel exclusions but discard contributing run status and residual-variance classification, regressing coverage inspection when replacing full-fit retention. Add bounded native per-run exclusion facts, without retaining full coefficient or variance maps. Acceptance: ordinary public API on JVM and JS preserves exact excluded absolute voxel and run identity, status, nonpositive/nonfinite variance classifications across narrow/wide blocks; healthy blocks carry no exclusion facts; selected effects/covariance remain unchanged.
set.title: Preserve run exclusion facts in bounded selected fixed-effects output
